steps.en: Swap the playwright dependency for the patched package at the same version
steps.zh: 把 playwright 依赖换成同版本的补丁包

steps.en: Run your existing Playwright script against Chrome, code unchanged
steps.zh: 原样运行已有的 Playwright 脚本，目标是 Chrome

steps.en: Skips the Runtime.Enable command that page scripts can detect
steps.zh: 不再发送会被页面脚本察觉的 Runtime.Enable 命令

steps.en: Finds the page's script context through a temporary binding, so evaluate() still works
steps.zh: 改用临时绑定找到页面脚本上下文，evaluate() 照常可用

value.en: Your Playwright code stops raising the Runtime.Enable flag — without a private fork or re-patching after every install
value.zh: 已有 Playwright 代码不再触发 Runtime.Enable 检测——不用自养分叉，也不用每次安装后重打补丁
